permission.title: This app needs your location
permission.body: GPS provides your location for directions. Searches and route requests send data to external map providers. This app does not record route history. The app speaks directions on its own; if your device has no voice for the chosen language, your screen reader reads them instead.
permission.startButtonHint: Tap to allow location access and enable spoken guidance
permission.spoken: Welcome to Taa-Thip Navigator. This app needs G P S to guide you by voice. Tap the button in the middle of the screen to allow it.

gps.acquiringSpoken: Finding your location. Please wait a moment.
gps.poorAccuracySpoken: Weak G P S signal. Your position may be off by about {{meters}} meters. Try moving to an open area away from tall buildings.
gps.recoveredSpoken: G P S signal is accurate again.
gps.staleSpoken: No G P S update for a while. The position shown may be out of date. Please walk with extra care.

maneuver.uturn: make a U-turn and walk back

search.label: Search for a destination
search.placeholder: Type a place name, e.g. Siam Paragon
search.noResultsSpoken: No places found. Try a different or shorter name.
search.resultsSpoken_one: Found {{count}} place. Tap it to choose your destination.
search.resultsSpoken_other: Found {{count}} places. Tap one to choose your destination.
search.hint: Type a name, then press Search
search.heading: Where do you want to go?
search.welcomeSpoken: Welcome to Taa-Thip Navigator. Type the name of a place you want to go to, then press Search.
search.selectedSpoken: {{destination}} set as your destination. Calculating the route.
search.approximate: No match for "{{query}}". These places have similar names
search.approximateSpoken: No place named {{query}} was found, but {{count}} places have similar names. Please listen to each name carefully before choosing, as they may not be what you want.

nav.calculatingSpoken: Calculating a walking route. Please wait a moment.
nav.routeReadySpoken: Route to {{destination}} found. Distance {{distance}}, about {{minutes}} minutes on foot.
nav.stepInstruction: Follow the route for about {{distance}}, then {{maneuver}}
nav.stepInstructionWithStreet: Follow the route for about {{distance}}, then {{maneuver}} near {{street}}
nav.maneuverNow: Near the point to {{maneuver}}. Check your surroundings first.
nav.arrivedSpoken: You have arrived near {{destination}}. Check the actual entrance. Press the Finish trip button when you are ready.
nav.arrivedNearSpoken: You have reached the end of the route. {{destination}} is about {{distance}} away. The walking route only goes this far. Please ask someone nearby for help to stay safe. Press the Finish trip button when you are ready.
nav.offRouteSpoken: Your position is off the route. Stop somewhere safe while a new route is checked.
nav.stoppedSpoken: Navigation stopped. You can choose a new destination.
nav.paused: Walking guidance paused: your location is not accurate enough or has stopped updating. Stop somewhere safe and wait for the signal to come back.
nav.resumed: Guidance is available again. Check your surroundings before continuing.
nav.confirmTurn: Confirm I have passed this turn
nav.safetyNote: Use with a cane or guide dog. This app cannot detect vehicles, obstacles or crossing signals, or tell you it is safe to cross. Keep this app in the foreground while walking; switching to another app stops guidance.
nav.finishedSpoken: Trip finished. Ready to search for a new destination.
nav.movingAway: You may be walking away from your destination
nav.movingAwaySpoken: You seem to be walking away from your destination. Please stop somewhere safe, then press Repeat instruction to hear the way again.
nav.vehicleSpeed: Moving faster than walking — guidance paused
nav.vehicleSpeedSpoken: You seem to be moving faster than walking, so walking guidance is paused. If you are in a vehicle, please stop guidance and search again after you get off.
nav.stillThereSpoken: You have not moved for a few minutes. Press Repeat instruction if you want to hear the way again.

whereAmI.failedSpoken: Could not find an address for this location. You may be offline. Please try again.
whereAmI.noPositionSpoken: Your location is not known yet. Please wait while the app finds it.

map.label: Map showing your current location
map.unavailable: The map could not load. Voice guidance still works normally.

actions.statusSpoken: Tracking your location. Accuracy is about {{meters}} meters.

errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: Location access was denied, so the app cannot guide you
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED_SPOKEN: Location access was denied. Please allow location for this site in your browser settings, then tap the retry button.
errors.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE_SPOKEN: No G P S signal. You may be indoors or in a shielded area. Please move to an open space and try again.
errors.TIMEOUT: Finding your location took too long
errors.TIMEOUT_SPOKEN: Finding your location took too long. Please tap the retry button.
errors.UNSUPPORTED: This browser does not support location
errors.UNSUPPORTED_SPOKEN: This browser does not support location. Please open the app in another browser such as a recent Chrome or Safari.
errors.INSECURE_CONTEXT_SPOKEN: This app needs a secure H T T P S connection to use your location. Please open it from a link starting with H T T P S.
errors.NETWORK_SPOKEN: Cannot reach the map service. If navigating, stop somewhere safe and check your connection.
errors.RATE_LIMITED_SPOKEN: The map service is temporarily rate limited. If navigating, stop somewhere safe. Wait and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: No walking route to this destination
errors.NOT_FOUND_SPOKEN: No walking route to this destination was found. Please choose a closer destination.
errors.PROVIDER_ERROR_SPOKEN: The map service is temporarily unavailable. If navigating, stop somewhere safe and retry.
errors.NO_POSITION: Your location is not known yet
errors.NO_POSITION_SPOKEN: Your location is not known yet, so a route cannot be calculated. Please wait until the app finds your location, then try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_SPOKEN: An unexpected problem occurred. If navigating, stop somewhere safe and retry.
errors.routeFailedSpoken: The route could not be calculated after several attempts. Navigation has stopped. Please stop somewhere safe and try again.
errors.speechUnsupported: App speech is unavailable in this browser. Use an enabled screen reader and test its announcements before starting.

hazard.crossroadsSpoken: Caution. A junction may be ahead. The map cannot check traffic or crossing signals. Do not cross based only on this app.
hazard.majorRoadSpoken: Caution near {{street}}. Traffic may be present. The map cannot confirm a safe crossing.

offline.banner: Offline: search and new routes are unavailable. Check your route and surroundings.
offline.lostSpoken: Offline. Search and new routes are unavailable. Stop somewhere safe if you leave the route.
offline.restoredSpoken: Back online. You can search and get routes again.

update.title: New version available
update.available: A new version of the app is ready
update.waitUntilStopped: Update available. Stop navigation before updating.

obstacle.title: Obstacles on the route
obstacle.none: No obstacles recorded in the map data
obstacle.noneSpoken: No obstacles are recorded in the map data for this route, but please keep using your cane as usual.
obstacle.failedSpoken: Could not check for obstacles. This does not mean the route is clear. Please walk with extra care.
obstacle.disclaimer: Only steps, gates and construction recorded in the map data can be found. It cannot detect parked motorcycles, street stalls, bins or standing signs, and it does not know whether a crossing has tactile paving. Always use your cane.
obstacle.stepsSpoken: Caution. In {{distance}} there are steps {{direction}} {{count}} {{handrail}}. Please check the first step with your cane before stepping.
obstacle.barrierSpoken: Caution. In {{distance}} there is a gate or bollard across the path.
obstacle.kerbSpoken: Caution. In {{distance}} there is a raised kerb to step over.
obstacle.constructionSpoken: Caution. In {{distance}} there is a construction zone. The path may be closed or diverted. Please slow down and ask for help if needed.
